notes: κατ᾽ ἰδίαν is one noncompositional unit under rule 45, privately answering to neither token separately, headed on the governed word; aside separately renders the ἀπο- of ἀπολαβόμενος and stays in the verb's unit under rule 15.
Each of τούς, τά and τῆς is emptied by a following αὐτοῦ under rule 20.
